preserved_rejected_draft.disposition: Not approved/adopted. Original draft directory and report remain byte-identical; findings fixed only in separate draft-02.

findings_resolved_in_source.initial_finding: The first draft used finished_at to authorize raw-file deletion, but Lane.command sets finished_at even after a failed worker stop or unresolved exit. The original tests raised before a child existed and did not exercise this case.
findings_resolved_in_source.correction: Cleanup now requires the exact single command/log, a finished record, no command_cleanup_error and type(exit_code) is int. Failed/interrupted stops, unresolved exits and no-child outcomes retain raw for the existing outer finalizer, with raw_removed=false.
findings_resolved_in_source.source_negative_controls: New mocked post-launch tests exercise actual Lane.command timeout handling with owner.stop failure/KeyboardInterrupt, unresolved poll, and successful reaping. A completed leader plus output-budget/stop-error case also preserves raw. All continue to assert identical original region exception/no diagnostic result.
findings_resolved_in_source.verification_state: Statically reviewed; root must execute controls.

findings_resolved_in_source.initial_finding: The first draft's current-user/type/path checks could decode or unlink a replacement ordinary file at the output path without proving it was the command-created inode.
findings_resolved_in_source.correction: An opt-in descriptor snapshot records device/inode/UID/file type immediately after exclusive xb open, before Popen. Captured raw-read identity must match before decoding/publishing; current canonical non-symlink regular-file identity must match again before unlink.
findings_resolved_in_source.source_negative_controls: A same-UID replacement containing otherwise-valid native text must not call make_diagnostic, publish a result or unlink either replacement/original. Normal completed output removal explicitly asserts the descriptor identity.
findings_resolved_in_source.verification_state: Statically reviewed; root must execute controls.

source_review.caller_delta: AST comparison finds only existing command/observe_kernel_regions changes, one collect_kernel_region_layout_failure method and one module import. All other caller AST, source/copy/signing/ownership/finalization paths remain identical.
source_review.ordinary_command_compatibility: capture_output_identity is a default-false keyword-only internal parameter, enabled only for the diagnostic. Removing that parameter and its one guarded fstat block yields the exact prior command AST. Ordinary command receipts do not gain output_file_identity. Reopened test_native_command_failures.py confirms why its isolated globals/exact ordinary fields must remain unchanged.
source_review.trigger: Only a normally completed exact helper command exit1, with no interruption/primary/cleanup-error flags, enters collection. Closed failure fields must show exact selected start/end, full native return, errno0, zero offset, RX, allowed max protection, non-submap, and only an oversized span. Unexpected/error/timeout cases never start otool.
source_review.ownership_and_identity: Collector rechecks watched outputs and target lifetime, descriptor-binds/hash-checks the original failure/helper/artifact, and verifies source/control context. Artifact size is bounded512MiB, helper1MiB, original failure4096B; reads are nonfollowing, regular-file/current-UID, descriptor/inode/size/mtime/ctime checked and bounded.
source_review.native_operation: Exactly one existing owned xcrun otool -arch arm64 -l call on the selected artifact;10second tool timeout,256KiB output cap. No task-memory read, privilege/entitlement change, broad mapping scan, extra app launch or fallback.
source_review.parser: Bounded UTF-8 output, exact artifact header, consecutive load-command framing, one __TEXT segment and one matching LC_UUID. Retains only closed numeric vmaddr/vmsize/fileoff/filesize/maxprot/initprot/nsects/flags plus UUID and native-output hash/length. Section/unrelated-command fields cannot replace the selected segment. Numeric extremes or unusual protection are diagnostic observations, not accepted geometry.
source_review.page_size_scope: os.sysconf(SC_PAGE_SIZE) is explicitly labeled host measurement with target_page_size_proven=false. No hardcoded16KiB, inferred target page size, interval rounding or automatic acceptance.
source_review.failure_and_privacy: Original region failure is rethrown with bare raise; diagnostic exceptions add only exception type. Kernel acceptance/output schemas stay byte-identical. Raw native output stays temporary and is removed only with custody proof; retained JSON excludes raw paths/symbols, source code or app memory.
source_review.source_control_binding: Existing closed .py control discovery includes the new decoder/test automatically after adoption; fresh whole-control bindings still required after all coordinated changes. This review is exact four-file approval, not a future closure hash.
source_review.python39_syntax: All held original/revised Python files independently parsed using stdlib AST feature_version(3,9); no project function/import execution.

declared_control_scope.count_basis: Unique class/test-method AST declarations, not unittest discovery or executed results.
declared_control_scope.driver: Only EXPECTED_COUNT204→226 changes relative to canonical driver; discovery/import-closure/count/no-skips/source-unchanged checks unchanged.
declared_control_scope.other_coverage: Retained18-method scope covers sole-size eligibility, native framing/UUID/numeric bounds, no rounding/provenance PASS, artifact/helper/failure mutation, pre/post unsafe target, invalid host page size, stale output, ordinary failures/interruption/budget, and exact C/Python acceptance pins. One existing test renamed/updated for conservative prelaunch retention.
declared_control_scope.execution: No tests, compilers, native tools or application runtime executed by author/reviewer for this held revision. Synthetic native text deliberately does not represent actual B26 Mach-O layout.

actual_B26_limit.future_scope: A successful diagnostic would add fresh artifact metadata only. It cannot retroactively supply B26 data or itself pass the C/Python provenance gate.
